Turkey, Greece, Egypt & Jordan | 26-Day Grand Tour
summary:
The 26-Day Turkey, Greece, Egypt & Jordan Tour builds a four-country route from Istanbul to the Dead Sea, moving through the eastern Mediterranean before continuing into the Middle East. Turkey covers Istanbul, Cappadocia and Ephesus, followed by Santorini and Athens in Greece. In Egypt, Cairo leads into a three-night Nile cruise through Upper Egypt and Luxor. Jordan completes the journey with Petra, Wadi Rum and the Dead Sea, giving the final days a distinctly desert-focused setting.
Operating between April and October, the itinerary uses regional flights and Greek ferries to connect its longer sectors. Hotels, the Nile cruise, specified meals, professional local guides, transfers, entrance fees and scheduled sightseeing are included.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport (IST or SAW), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The rest of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Oldcity Walking tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Bosphorus Cruise- Flight to Cappadocia
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, visit the historic Spice Bazaar, also known as the Egyptian Bazaar, famous for its colorful spices, sweets, and local products since 1665. Continue with a memorable Bosphorus cruise, sailing between Europe and Asia along one of the world’s most scenic waterways. After the tour, transfer to the airport at 15:00 for your flight to Nevsehir at 18:45. Upon arrival at 20:10, and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: North Cappadocia Tour
itinerary.text:
Optional: Early morning hot air balloon ride over Cappadocia.
After breakfast at 10:00, enjoy a full-day tour of North Cappadocia. Visit Uchisar Castle for panoramic views, followed by Rose Valley, Pasabag, and the Zelve Open Air Museum, famous for fairy chimneys and cave dwellings. After lunch, continue to Devrent Valley and Three Beauties, then visit the charming towns of Urgup and Avanos, known for traditional pottery. After the tour, return to the hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: South Cappadocia Tour -Flight to Izmir
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a full-day tour of South Cappadocia. Visit Ortahisar Castle, the former Greek village of Mustafapaşa, and the Roman ruins of Sobesos Ancient City. Continue to Soğanlı Valley for a scenic walk through its cave churches, followed by lunch. After lunch, explore Kaymakli Underground City, one of Cappadocia’s most famous underground settlements. After the tour, transfer to Kayseri Airport for your flight to Izmir at 22:50. Upon arrival at 00:20, meet and transfer to Kusadasi. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Day trip to Pamukkale
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 07:30, depart for Pamukkale to explore its famous white travertine terraces and the ancient city of Hierapolis. Guests may also enjoy swimming at the famous Cleopatra Antique Pools (optional, extra entrance fee applies). After the tour, drive back to Kusadasi. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Ephesus tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a guided tour of Ephesus, visiting highlights such as the Odeon, Library of Celsus, Temple of Hadrian, Fountain of Trajan, and the Great Theatre. Continue to the ruins of the Temple of Artemis, followed by lunch and a visit to the House of the Virgin Mary. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Izmir to Santorini Via Athens by Flight
itinerary.text:
Breakfast. Free time, then transfer to Izmir Airport for flight to Santorini via Athens (18:00).
Arrival at 00:30. Meet & transfer to hotel. Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Free day in Santorini
itinerary.text: Breakfast. Free day to relax on the island’s beaches or explore Fira and its charming cliffside streets. Optional boat or bus tours to the volcano and nearby islands are available. Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Santorini to Mykonos By Ferry
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel in Santorini. Transfer to the port for your ferry to Mykonos.
Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. Free time to relax, explore Mykonos Town. Overnight in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Free day in Mykonos
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel in Mykonos. Free day to explore Mykonos Town and discover the island’s charming alleys, boutique shops, cafés, and beautiful beaches. In the evening, enjoy Mykonos’ famous nightlife and lively atmosphere. Overnight in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Mykonos to Athens By Ferry
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel in Mykonos. Check-out and transfer to the port for your ferry to Athens.
Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and enjoy free time at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Half day Athens City Tour
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel in Athens. Enjoy a half-day city tour including the Acropolis of Athens, Acropolis Museum, and the iconic Parthenon. Continue sightseeing with views of the Parliament, Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, National Library, Presidential Palace, Panathenaic Stadium, Temple of Olympian Zeus, and Arch of Hadrian. Return to the hotel and enjoy free time at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Athens to Cairo by Flight
itinerary.text:
Breakfast. Check-out and transfer to Athens Airport for flight to Cairo (12:50).
Arrival at 14:20. Meet & transfer to hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Giza Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.text: Meet your guide and visit Memphis, the ancient capital of Egypt, and see the impressive statue of Ramesses II. Continue to Saqqara to explore the famous Pyramid of Djoser. Afterwards, visit the legendary Giza pyramid complex and admire the iconic Great Sphinx of Giza. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Flight from Cairo to Aswan- Nile Cruise
itinerary.text:
Early breakfast box and transfer to the airport for your morning flight from Cairo to Aswan (06:30–07:50).
Upon arrival, meet your guide and transfer to board your 3-night Nile River cruise before lunch. Begin sightseeing in Aswan with a visit to the impressive Aswan High Dam, followed by the beautiful Philae Temple located on Agilkia Island and dedicated to the goddess Isis. Return to the cruise ship. Overnight on board the Nile cruise.

itinerary.title: Nile Cruise- Kom Ombo & Edfu Tour
itinerary.text: Sail to Kom Ombo and visit the Temple of Kom Ombo, dedicated to the crocodile god Sobek. Continue sailing to Edfu and explore the remarkably preserved Temple of Edfu, dedicated to the falcon god Horus. Return to the cruise ship and continue sailing along the Nile River. Overnight on board the Nile cruise.

itinerary.title: Nile Cruise- Luxor Sightseeing
itinerary.text: Sail along the Nile River to Esna and continue onward to Luxor. Begin exploring the West Bank of Luxor with a visit to the legendary Valley of the Kings, burial site of many ancient pharaohs. Continue to the magnificent Mortuary Temple of Hatshepsut, dedicated to Egypt’s famous female pharaoh. End the tour with a stop at the impressive Colossi of Memnon. Return to the cruise ship. Overnight on board the Nile cruise.

itinerary.title: Luxor to Cairo by Flight
itinerary.text: Breakfast onboard and disembark in Luxor. Visit the magnificent Luxor Temple and the vast Karnak Temple Complex, one of the largest religious sites in the world. Enjoy some free time before transfer to the airport for your flight to Cairo. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Egyptian Museum, Citadel, Old Cairo
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel in Cairo. Visit the impressive Grand Egyptian Museum and the historic Cairo Citadel, including the beautiful Mosque of Muhammad Ali. Continue to explore Old Cairo with visits to the The Hanging Church and Saints Sergius and Bacchus Church (Abu Serga Church). End the day at the famous Khan el-Khalili Bazaar. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Cairo to Amman by Flight
itinerary.text:
Breakfast. Check-out and transfer to Cairo Airport for flight to Amman (13:05).
Arrival at 15:30. Transfer to hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Visit Jerash and Ajloun
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel in Amman. Enjoy a city tour including the Amman Citadel, Roman Theater, and the Folklore Museum. Continue to Ajloun to visit the historic Ajloun Castle. Afterwards, explore Jerash, one of the best-preserved ancient Greco-Roman cities in the Middle East. Return to Amman for overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Visiting Madaba Mt Nebo / Kerak
itinerary.text: Visit Saint George's Church in Madaba to admire the famous Byzantine mosaic map of the Holy Land. Continue to Mount Nebo, believed to be the place where Moses viewed the Promised Land, and enjoy panoramic views over the Jordan Valley and the Dead Sea. Drive along the scenic Al-Mujeb route to Kerak and visit the impressive Kerak Castle, one of the region’s most important Crusader fortresses. Continue south to Petra for overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Visit Petra and Wadi Rum
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel in Petra. Explore the ancient Nabataean city of Petra, walking through the dramatic Siq to reach the iconic Al-Khazneh (Treasury). Continue to the Street of Facades, Royal Tombs, and Pharaoh’s Castle. Afterwards, drive to Wadi Rum for a 4x4 jeep safari through the spectacular desert landscapes. Overnight in a desert camp in Wadi Rum.

itinerary.title: Visit Dead Sea and then return Amman
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel and drive to the Dead Sea, the lowest point on Earth. Enjoy free time to relax, swim, and float in its mineral-rich waters. Later, return to Amman for overnight stay, with the option to stay overnight at a Dead Sea resort hotel instead.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Amman Airport
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel in Amman
Check-out and transfer to Queen Alia International Airport for departure flight

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 26-Day Middle East – Turkey, Jordan, Greece & Egypt Package?
faqs.a: This comprehensive 26-day journey covers four of the world's most fascinating destinations. The itinerary includes Istanbul, Cappadocia, Pamukkale, and Ephesus in Turkey; Athens, Mykonos, and Santorini in Greece; Cairo, Luxor, and Aswan in Egypt; and Amman, Petra, Wadi Rum, and the Dead Sea in Jordan. The tour combines ancient civilizations, religious heritage, spectacular landscapes, and vibrant cultures across 25 nights and 26 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 26-Day Middle East – Turkey, Jordan, Greece & Egypt Package cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €5,975 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, airport and hotel transfers, domestic transportation, and seven domestic flights. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and accommodation category.

faqs.q: Are flights included in the package?
faqs.a: Yes, seven domestic flights are included within the itinerary to ensure comfortable and efficient travel between major destinations. International flights to and from the tour are not included unless specifically stated.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes carefully selected hotels throughout Turkey, Greece, Egypt, and Jordan. Daily breakfast is included, with additional meals provided according to the itinerary. Accommodations are chosen for their comfort, quality, and convenient locations.

Yes, professional English-speaking guides accompany the scheduled sightseeing tours in each country. Your guides will provide expert commentary on the history, archaeology, culture, and traditions of the destinations visited.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to the Middle East and Mediterranean region?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors who want a comprehensive introduction to four extraordinary countries. It combines the region's most iconic landmarks, historical sites, and natural wonders in a single unforgettable journey.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, historic city centers, desert landscapes, museums, and uneven terrain. Most visitors with average fitness levels can comfortably participate throughout the itinerary.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of the tour?
faqs.a: Highlights include the historic treasures of Istanbul, the fairy chimneys of Cappadocia, the ancient city of Ephesus, the terraces of Pamukkale, the stunning islands of Santorini and Mykonos, the Acropolis of Athens, the Pyramids of Giza, the temples of Luxor and Aswan, the rose-red city of Petra, the dramatic desert landscapes of Wadi Rum, and the unique floating experience at the Dead Sea.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 26-Day Middle East – Turkey, Jordan, Greece & Egypt Package?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 60 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 60 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, airline conditions, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is strongly recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the 26-Day Middle East – Turkey, Jordan, Greece & Egypt Package be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include additional destinations, extend your stay in any of the countries, or modify the itinerary to match your travel interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
